title: A Name at the Camp Fire
summary: Iron Hollow's opinion of the player has fallen far enough that its people mark them.

hooks.situation: {player}'s name has been said at the camp fire, and not kindly. Somebody will be sent. It may as well be you.

options.label: Warn them, out of the side of your mouth

effects.text: Tell {player}, out of the side of your mouth, that their name was said at the Hollow's fire, and not kindly.

options.label: Make sure they know the Hollow has noticed

effects.text: Make sure {player} knows the Hollow has noticed them. Stand too close. Use their name.

options.label: Offer them a way out of the valley

effects.text: Offer {player} a quiet word: the Hollow forgets people who leave the valley before Collection Night.

options.label: Say nothing; keep out of it
